description: A battalion S-6 communications officer must publish the next day's protected-data network access plan for the command video brief, logistics synchronization, and clinic records services, assigning each service a network segment and maintenance window while recording the required configuration controls.

shared_context.S1: The battalion has three protected network segments available for tomorrow: Segment Red, Segment Blue, and Segment Green.
shared_context.S2: The available network service windows are 0800-0900, 1000-1100, and 1400-1500, and each service must receive one segment and one window.
shared_context.S3: The three services requiring scheduled access are the command video brief, the logistics synchronization feed, and the clinic records system.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Alvarez publishes the binding network access plan after the routine daily change-control board asks the operations, logistics, and medical representatives for service requirements.
shared_context.S5: Each service must have a documented configuration control before its access window begins.

PF1.text: The command video brief must use Segment Green and the 1400-1500 window because the partner headquarters bridge is configured only for that segment and time; Capt. Rowan received the bridge configuration confirmation this morning, but it is not yet on the change-control board slide.

PF2.text: The logistics synchronization feed must use Segment Blue and the 1000-1100 window because its legacy terminal accepts only the Blue segment profile and the depot upload begins at 1000; Lt. Mensah confirmed the terminal profile with the depot technician today, but the update has not been added to the network request.

PF3.text: The clinic records system must use Segment Red and the 0800-0900 window because the clinic server's isolation certificate is valid only on Red and the morning patient-file reconciliation starts at 0800; Lt. Patel received the certificate record from the clinic administrator this morning, but it has not been entered in the access worksheet.

acceptance_conditions: The command video brief must be assigned to Segment Green during 1400-1500.
The logistics synchronization feed must be assigned to Segment Blue during 1000-1100.
The clinic records system must be assigned to Segment Red during 0800-0900.
A bridge-profile configuration control must be recorded for the command video brief.
A legacy-terminal profile verification must be recorded for the logistics synchronization feed.
An isolation-certificate verification must be recorded for the clinic records system.
The clinic isolation-certificate fact must be cited in the decision-maker's justification.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'bridge_profile_configuration' and c['target'] == 'command video brief' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'legacy_terminal_verification' and c['target'] == 'logistics synchronization feed' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'isolation_certificate_verification' and c['target'] == 'clinic records system' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The partner bridge configuration changes the command video brief to Segment Green and 1400-1500 and requires the bridge-profile configuration control.
The legacy terminal and depot upload timing change the logistics synchronization feed to Segment Blue and 1000-1100 and require the legacy-terminal verification.
The clinic isolation certificate and 0800 reconciliation change the clinic records system to Segment Red and 0800-0900 and require the isolation-certificate verification and citation.
